gitCommit.subject: Address PR #282 review feedback for mobile web parity.
gitCommit.body:
Address PR #282 review feedback for mobile web parity.

Cache ionicon SVGs, dispatch month-picker events instead of window globals,
remove the no-op page-transition controller, and expand finances request
specs plus mobile-web e2e coverage for the statement upload pricing gate.
